correctness.rationale: Exact matching-number additivity yields the three-term simplicial union. The four sphere inputs follow from the published cyclic-polytope theorem for all lengths at least six. Null maps between spheres two dimensions apart, Mayer--Vietoris, and the naturality isomorphism for the common intersection imply Z^2 and Z in the two asserted adjacent degrees over the integers, with no extension or torsion ambiguity. Five finite mod-two computations corroborate but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: A natural infinite two-cycle family exhibits two adjacent nonzero reduced integral homology groups, unlike the one-cycle sphere. The exact rank two in the lower degree and absence of torsion are not determined by general Leray bounds; includes both odd and even lengths. An exact natural homology classification is independently useful without claiming a sphere-wedge splitting.
